scope.purpose: Pre-register a fair branch comparison before any larger run.
scope.truth_definition: The capture package may contain truth for a post-run evaluator only; truth is not an estimator input.

shared_capture_and_fence.branch_reuse_rule: Generate one capture package for each stratum/seed, then run both branches against that exact package.

shared_adc.observation_budget_unit: 400 frame ADC capture; no branch may request additional frames or a regenerated ADC stream

shared_adxl.observation_budget_unit: 4000 sample, 3-axis ADXL capture; the estimator consumes the structural axis only

frozen_calibration_test_fence.guard_source: calibration ADC and ADXL capture arrays plus monotonic timestamps only
frozen_calibration_test_fence.branch_rule: Both branches consume the same guards.json and must not recompute or update limits from frozen-test values.
frozen_calibration_test_fence.guard_failure_rule: A rejected branch is an abstention for the primary metric; do not score its test RMSE as zero.

observation_budget.fairness_unit: The same package, ADC cube, ADXL stream, time axis, and 200/200 fence are supplied to each branch.

branches.label: RO-all-channel
branches.definition: Range FFT and range-only complex observation using all available virtual channels; no angle map, AoA/MUSIC/ML angle refinement, or angle-derived beta may be used.
branches.implementation_constraint: The current checkout has no RO-all-channel estimator. A smoke run must fail closed with an unavailable-adapter record rather than invoking or relabeling the RA route.
branches.beta_source: branch-defined range-only calibration or an explicitly declared fixed value; angle_geometry is prohibited
branches.target_count_rule: Record the actual number of range-only targets/observations selected; never copy RA target count.

branches.label: RA
branches.definition: Range FFT plus angle processing, target detection, local MUSIC/ML refinement, target selection, angle-geometry beta, ADXL preintegration, and structural Kalman update.
branches.target_count_rule: Record the target count reported by the actual output summary and selected-target arrays.

forbidden_estimator_inputs: post-run RMSE or any evaluator output
estimator_input_contract.audit_requirement: Record estimator_input_manifest, truth_used_by_estimator=false, and q_proxy_used_by_estimator=false for every branch attempt.

primary.name: all_trial_success
primary.definition: accepted AND finite RMSE on the frozen test AND RMSE <= 0.010 mm
primary.denominator: all pre-registered branch trials, including guard rejects and unavailable-adapter abstentions

coverage.name: coverage
coverage.definition: accepted branch trials / pre-registered branch trials

accepted_only_rmse.name: accepted_only_rmse
accepted_only_rmse.definition: RMSE distribution among accepted branch trials only
accepted_only_rmse.interpretation: Descriptive appendix metric; never substitute for all_trial_success.

metrics.rmse_reference: Use the fixed physical frame-grid reference and the same cold-start rule for both branches; compute it outside the estimator from post-run truth.

run_order: record git status and source hashes
build exactly one package per scenario/seed
run each branch against the same package and guards
compute post-run metrics without exposing truth to either estimator
audit route labels, beta source, target count, input hashes, and branch mixing
stop; do not start the 40-seed matrix
stop_conditions: RO adapter unavailable: record abstention and stop without RA fallback
shared ADC/ADXL or guard hash mismatch: stop the smoke
truth/q_proxy observed in estimator input: stop and mark invalid
actual route or beta source does not match declared branch: stop and mark invalid

required_cross_branch_checks: same shared package hash per scenario/seed
same ADC input hash per scenario/seed
same ADXL input hash per scenario/seed
RO unavailable rows never contain RA output artifacts
beta source agrees with branch definition
target count is read from actual branch output
